name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Famous Fried Chicken (Peel Crispy Skin Mod) & Mashed Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: Plaza Inn (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Disneyland's most iconic comfort meal; the moist white-meat chicken breast inside the crust is tender and low-residue once you peel off most of the heavily seasoned, deep-fried skin.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel away the thick fried skin/breading from the chicken breast to cut the fryer oil and black pepper by 80%, eat with mashed potatoes and a soft biscuit, and ask for gravy on the side.
watchOuts: The outer fried skin is rich in fryer oil and pepper—always remove most of the crust if not in deep remission, or order the Plaza Inn Pot Roast instead
